== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English original and later English Errata articles for [[Red 5]]. Columns are Original and PC Errata (Appendix A Independent icon on the Holotable E face) only. Glossary 2.0 has no Red 5 replacement text. Do not transclude onto Japanese, Revised, Two-Player, foil, or (V) articles. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per real Errata face; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
